label: Bird kind
description: Bird species and distinctive domestic breeds, from garden songbirds and parrots to seabirds and flightless birds.
notes: Bird species and recognizable domestic breeds belong here as complete singular common names; a becomes an where pronunciation requires it. animal.species supplies broad animal choices, while this list distinguishes bird identities rather than poses or plumage mutations. Kind chips are browsing categories rather than a taxonomy and overlap for familiar garden birds, flightless waterbirds, and tropical parrots. Glosses describe characteristic adult plumage, often the brighter male where sexes differ.
